en: Be not afraid of greatness: some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon 'em.
zh: 不要害怕伟大：有人生而伟大，有人成就伟大，有人被迫伟大。
line: Be not afraid of greatness: some are born great, some achieve greatness, and some have greatness thrust upon 'em. — William Shakespeare

word.zh: n. 大陆，洲；a. 自制的
word.ex: Africa is a very large continent.
word.exzh: 非洲是一块非常大的大陆。
